name: chart
title: Chart
description: How Conare draws a number: bars per day under a meter's total and the week's change, lines for series over time, bars for shares of a total, and one split bar for a whole in parts. A 1px grid, axes from 0, and pointing reads a value.
use_for: Queries per day, search latency, documents written, what a bill is made of. Every series is labeled; the caption says what it counts.
never: Colour alone to tell series apart: the third line is dashed and every series is in the legend
Bars that regrow on every hover: they rise once

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from 'vue'

// The way a number moved, in the website button's pixel arrow (usage/TrendArrow.vue): lit squares on a grid of dim
// ones, red going up, ink going down (turned over). `bare` is a solid pixel triangle with no grid, for beside a stat.
// It holds still: the branch's step on card hover is left out, since icons never move on hover.
const props = defineProps<{ down?: boolean, bare?: boolean }>()
const CELL = 3
const SIZE = 5
const ROWS = computed(() => (props.bare ? 3 : SIZE))
const INK = computed(() => (props.bare ? CELL : 2))
const WIDE = computed(() => SIZE * CELL - (props.bare ? 0 : 1))
const TALL = computed(() => ROWS.value * CELL - (props.bare ? 0 : 1))
const GRID = Array.from({ length: SIZE * SIZE }, (_, k) => [k % SIZE, Math.floor(k / SIZE)] as const)
// [column, row] of the lit squares, pointing up.
const ARROW: Array<[number, number]> = [[2, 0], [1, 1], [2, 1], [3, 1], [0, 2], [2, 2], [4, 2], [2, 3], [2, 4]]
const TRIANGLE: Array<[number, number]> = [[2, 0], [1, 1], [2, 1], [3, 1], [0, 2], [1, 2], [2, 2], [3, 2], [4, 2]]
const lit = computed(() => (props.bare ? TRIANGLE : ARROW))
</script>

<template>
  <svg data-ds="trend-arrow" class="shrink-0 overflow-hidden" :class="down && 'rotate-180'" :width="WIDE" :height="TALL" :viewBox="`0 0 ${WIDE} ${TALL}`" aria-hidden="true">
    <g v-if="!bare" class="fill-ds-neutral-700"><rect v-for="[x, y] in GRID" :key="`${x}-${y}`" :x="x * CELL" :y="y * CELL" width="2" height="2" /></g>
    <g :class="down ? 'fill-fg' : 'fill-edge-accent'"><rect v-for="[x, y] in lit" :key="`${x}-${y}`" :x="x * CELL" :y="y * CELL" :width="INK" :height="INK" /></g>
  </svg>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import LineChart from '@/components/ui/LineChart.vue'
// Search latency, p50 and p95, as smoothed lines over a day.
const hour = (i: number) => Date.UTC(2026, 9, 29, i)
const latency = [
  { label: 'p50', points: Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({ t: hour(i), v: 230 + ((i * 13) % 7) * 3 })) },
  { label: 'p95', points: Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({ t: hour(i), v: 400 + ((i * 17) % 9) * 6 })) },
]
const ms = (v: number) => `${Math.round(v)} ms`
</script>

<template>
  <LineChart title="Search latency, last 24 hours" :series="latency" :format="ms" :smooth="3" bare />
</template>

examples.label: A whole in parts
examples.content:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import SplitBar from '@/components/ui/SplitBar.vue'
// A whole in parts, as Billing's prices draw it: one bar, the largest part first, a red mark over the part the row
// pointed at names, and one block gliding down the rows.
const usd = (cents: number) => (cents / 100).toLocaleString('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: 'USD' })
const parts = [
  { name: 'Queries', detail: '$1.00 per 1,000 queries', value: 18431 },
  { name: 'Documents', detail: '$1.00 per 1,000 pages', value: 4821 },
  { name: 'Indexing', detail: '$0.05 per 1M tokens', value: 1928 },
  { name: 'Storage', detail: '$0.33 per GB a month', value: 268 },
].map(p => ({ ...p, display: usd(p.value) }))
const at = ref(0)
</script>

<template>
  <SplitBar v-model="at" :parts="parts" label="This month's bill by part" />
</template>

<script type="module">
  const hour = (i) => Date.UTC(2026, 9, 29, i)
  const chart = document.querySelector('conare-line-chart')
  chart.format = (v) => `${Math.round(v)} ms`
  chart.series = [
    { label: 'p50', points: Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({ t: hour(i), v: 230 + ((i * 13) % 7) * 3 })) },
    { label: 'p95', points: Array.from({ length: 24 }, (_, i) => ({ t: hour(i), v: 400 + ((i * 17) % 9) * 6 })) },
  ]
</script>
